title: Stateful Combo Ordering Flow Refactor Plan
objective: Replace the current brittle, stateless combo ordering function with a robust, stateful architecture to handle multiple, complex combo types and provide a smooth, error-free user experience.

phases.name: Create the Stateful Combo Order Manager

steps.description: This file will contain the ComboOrderManager class, which will manage the state of active combo orders using a dictionary keyed by call_sid.
Add a DISHES_ALIASES_EN dictionary. Remove the old CUSTOMIZED_COMBO_FLOW_TOOL_SCHEMA_EN_OPENAI and replace it with START_COMBO_ORDER_TOOL_SCHEMA and PROCESS_COMBO_SELECTION_TOOL_SCHEMA.
Import and instantiate the ComboOrderManager. Remove old combo functions (handle_customized_combo_flow, get_next_combo_step).

steps.action: Implement new tool handlers in english_tool_logic.py
steps.description: Create handle_start_combo_order and handle_process_combo_selection functions to interface with the new manager.

steps.action: Update the main function call dispatcher
steps.description: Modify the handle_function_call function in english_tool_logic.py to route calls to the new combo handlers.
Update the order summary handler to retrieve completed combo details from the ComboOrderManager instead of a simple variation string.
Perform a final review of all changes and ensure the new flow works as expected for both 'Customized Combo' and 'COMBO #1'.
